name: Colotomic gong cycle
desc: A slow Javanese colotomic gongan: the great gong ageng sounds once every four cycles, kenong and kempul (gong2 + agogo) mark the interior subdivisions, and a steady kethuk woodblock pulse breathes on opposite-phase pan/lpf sweeps over 48 cycles. Sparse is the skeletal gong+kethuk frame; full fills the colotomic ensemble with a kethuk flurry every 8 bars; peak doubles the gong and spins agogo/slitdrum euclid rotations through the weave.

code.full: stack(s("<gong ~ ~ ~>").gain(${gain}).room(${room}), s("gong2 ~ ~ gong2 ~ ~ gong2 ~").gain(${gain}*.5).room(${room}).pan(cosine.range(.4,.6).slow(32)), s("~ ~ agogo ~ ~ agogo ~ ~").gain(${gain}*.45).pan(.6), s("woodblock*8").gain("[.3 .14 .22 .12]*2").pan(sine.range(.35,.65).slow(24)).every(8, x=>x.ply(2)), s("~ slitdrum ~ slitdrum").gain(${gain}*.3)).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}).slow(48)).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("<gong ~ gong ~>").gain(${gain}).room(${room}), s("gong2 ~ gong2 ~ gong2 ~ gong2 ~").gain(${gain}*.5).pan(cosine.range(.35,.65).slow(24)), s("agogo(3,8,<0 2 4>)").gain(${gain}*.42).pan(sine.range(.4,.6).slow(16)), s("woodblock*16").gain("[.3 .12 .2 .1]*4").mask("<1 1 1 0>").pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(16)).every(4, x=>x.ply(2)), s("slitdrum(5,8,<0 2 4 6>)").gain(${gain}*.3)).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.2).slow(24)).fast(${rate}).orbit(1).play()
